description:
One bankruptcy case's announcement history and current procedural stage, newest
first.

`current_stage` is the most recent announcement's type. The registry publishes
no case-level status record, so the latest publication is the only statement of
where the case stands, and `debtor_code`, `debtor_name` and `court_name` are
read off that same announcement.

Check `mirror.ready` to tell "no proceedings published" apart from an unsynced
mirror.
name: ua_bankruptcy__get_case
title: Get Bankruptcy Case
